rationale: With only 6 minutes to close, any position opened now faces forced market liquidation at the bell, creating unacceptable slippage risk on a small-float stock with a wide intraday range ($10.27–$12.20). Price action in the last 5 candles shows near-complete stasis (11.12–11.14 range, minimal volume), offering no directional signal to exploit. The account is already down on the day and the risk/reward of a 6-minute forced-close trade does not justify deployment.
